senses.gloss: (cmp. כָּעַס) to be dark, ugly, repulsive (cmp. אוּכְמָא).—Part. pass. כָּעוּר, כָּאוּר; f. כְּעוּרָה; pl. כְּעוּרִים, כְּעוּרִין; כְּעוּרוֹת, כְּא׳

units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 36:1">Gen. R. s. 36</cite> <he>לפיכך … כ׳ ומפוחם</he> therefore shall this man (thou) be ugly and black.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Kamma 9:4">B. Kam. IX, 4</cite> (<cite ref="Bava Kamma 100b:2">100ᵇ</cite>) <he>צבעו כ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="K00752"><he>כַּלְכּוּס</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Esther Rabbah 3:14">Esth. R. to I, 12</cite> <he>אם רואין אותי כ׳</he> if they find me ungainly.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 5:11:5">Cant. R. to V, 11</cite>; a. fr.—
senses.label: a

units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 7:6:7">Y. Keth. VII, 31ᶜ</cite> top <he>כא׳ הדבר תצא</he> that is indecent conduct, and cause for divorce; (<cite ref="Yevamot 24b">Yeb. 24ᵇ</cite>, sq. <he>מכוער</he>).
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 60:5">Gen. R. s. 60</cite> <he>שכ׳ לאיש וכ׳</he> for it is unbecoming for a man to walk behind a woman.—
senses.label: b

units: <cite ref="Chullin 115b">Ḥull. 115ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Chullin 117a">117ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Kiddushin 9b:7">Kidd. 9ᵇ</cite> <he>כעורה זו ששנה וכ׳</he> is what R. … taught to be rejected?—
<cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Batra 2:2">Tosef. Kel. B. Bath. II, 2</cite> <he>כ׳ מזו טימא וכ׳</he> something more strange than this (or more inappropriate to be used as a seat) did R. … declare unclean.
senses.label: c

senses.gloss: to make or declare repulsive.—Part. pass. מְכוֹעָר, f. מְכוֹעֶרֶת; pl. מְכוֹעָרִין, מְכוֹעָרוֹת = כָּעוּר &c.
units: <cite ref="Ketubot 105a:12">Keth. 105ᵃ</cite> <he>מ׳ הדיין וכ׳</he> contemptible is the judge who receives fees for giving judgment.
<cite ref="Yoma 86a:13">Yoma 86ᵃ</cite> <he>כמה מכ׳ דרכיו</he> how mean are his ways!; a. fr.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 17:7">Gen. R. s. 17</cite> <he>הִתְכָּעַרְתִּי בעיניו</he> I appeared repulsive to him.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 45:6">Gen. R. s. 45</cite> <he>מִתְכָּעֶרֶת ומתעזבת</he> she becomes ungainly and is neglected.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 2:14">Cant. R. to II, 14</cite> <he>מתכ׳ ומתועבת</he>, v. <cite ref="V00773"><he>תָּעַב</he></cite>.
